native_mechanisms: Find every match cell (same-dye knot crossing) at once by a single broadcast 'shadow' test, never scanning the grid cell by cell
Compute the cost of the empty stretch between consecutive match cells in closed form from the two index offsets, never laying down or visiting intermediate cells
Keep at each match cell only the best running tally per slip-state (one gap-shift spent or not) and drop every dominated tally
core_technique: Banded Needleman-Wunsch computed as a SIMD anti-diagonal wavefront (with b reversed for contiguous diagonal access), band half-width derived from a score lower bound (diagonal identity score plus a w=8 probe), plus a rolling-row exact NW fallback for small n.
